title: Payzer X
tagline: Payzer X removes most of the friction associated with using web3 wallets and interacting with dapps.
description: Payzer X facilitates the adoption of crypto technology by making use of account abstraction to remove barriers when approaching people with no prior knowledge of web3. At the same time Payzer X allows us to make payments to third parties without the need to install any wallet, allowing us to authenticate with social networks and also allows us to make automatic debits to achieve a better experience when making payments with crypto
